review_candidates.title: FA Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description The Corindo Amagi Putra (CAP) Group is a growing food and beverage company dedicated to offering high-quality foods, pastries, desserts, bakeries, and beverages, supported by warm and friendly service in modern, casual settings. Founded in 2016, CAP Group began as the official franchisee of Corica Pastries in Indonesia and has expanded successfully with multiple outlets in Surabaya and Jakarta. The group also operates Chao Phraya Thai Fine Cuisine, one of the first Thai fine-dining restaurants in Surabaya, recognized by the Ambassador of Thailand for its role in promoting Thai cuisine and cultural exchange. CAP Group offers opportunities to work in a dynamic, customer-focused environment with strong ambitions for growth in Indonesia’s culinary scene. Role Description The FA Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Surabaya, responsible for overseeing financial and accounting activities across CAP Group’s business units. The role includes managing daily accounting operations, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting, and overseeing budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management. The FA Manager will coordinate audits, maintain compliance with relevant regulations and company policies, and support decision-making with financial analysis and performance reviews. This position collaborates closely with management and operations teams to optimize financial processes, control costs, and support strategic initiatives that drive business growth. The FA Manager will also lead and develop the finance and accounting team, promoting strong internal controls and continuous improvement. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Finance and Financial Services skills, including financial reporting, budgeting, and cash flow management. Candidates should possess solid Accounting skills, covering general ledger management, cost accounting, and familiarity with accounting standards. Candidates should possess Auditing skills, including experience with internal controls, compliance reviews, and coordination with external auditors. Candidates should possess Analytical Skills, with the ability to interpret financial data, perform variance analysis, and support business decisions. Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CA, or equivalent) are an advantage. Experience in managing finance and accounting teams, preferably in the food and beverage, hospitality, or retail sector. Proficiency in financial and accounting software, strong Excel skills, and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. Effective communication, leadership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work on-site and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

review_candidates.title: Director, Customer Implementations
review_candidates.description: About 3E 3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges. Join us and make an impact! About The Role We are looking for a leader to enhance our global implementation function. This influential role is ideal for a customer-focused individual who can bring structure, clarity, and strong delivery discipline to complex enterprise implementations. You will lead a global team responsible for new customer implementations, post-sale value realization, and project work that supports renewals and expansions. Your efforts will improve delivery across 3E’s product portfolio by building scalable processes, increasing project visibility, managing risks, and accelerating customer value. This role reports to the VP of Customer Experience and collaborates closely with leaders across 3E. If you are AI-forward, passionate about customer success, and understand the importance of implementation in building trust and lasting partnerships, we would love to connect with you! Location: This position supports remote work in EST, and candidates should be based near one of our U.S. East Coast office locations: Bethesda, MD, Canton, OH, or Charlottesville, VA. What You’ll Do Lead, coach, and develop a global Customer Implementations team responsible for complex enterprise deployments across 3E’s product portfolio. Strengthen implementation execution by setting clear expectations, operating rhythms, delivery standards, and accountability across the team. Define and continuously raise the standard for implementation excellence across delivery quality, milestone discipline, risk management, customer communication, go-live readiness, and value realization. Build scalable implementation practices, including project plans, governance models, RACI frameworks, resource planning, delivery controls, and consistent customer communication. Establish stronger risk management practices to identify project health concerns, customer escalations, resource constraints, and delivery risks before they impact outcomes. Improve visibility into project health, customer risk, capacity, and delivery performance through dashboards, tools, and consistent reporting. Lead through ambiguity, legacy processes, and complex customer needs by bringing structure, focus, and practical solutions without slowing momentum. Partner with Customer Experience, Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Product, Support, Technology, and Business Line leaders to strengthen handoffs, resolve risks, and support customer outcomes. Strengthen team capability by coaching talent, addressing performance gaps, improving cross-product knowledge, and building a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery. Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, workflow tools, and digital workers to reduce manual work, improve reporting accuracy, and scale implementation operations. Capture insights from implementations and post-sale project work to support renewals, expansion opportunities, account planning, and long-term customer success. Required Qualifications What Makes You a Great Fit: 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS implementation, professional services, information services, customer onboarding, and delivery operations, with a strong focus on driving customer value and revenue impact. 6+ years of experience leading global, distributed, or multi-region teams in high-growth, scale-up, or PE-backed environments. Proven track record leading complex enterprise software implementations, including multi-product deployments and programs with significant data, integration, or regulatory complexity. Experience supporting enterprise products or implementation portfolios with meaningful commercial scale, ideally above $5M USD in revenue or ARR. Strong ability to connect implementation efforts to customer value, with commercial awareness driving ACV, renewals, expansion opportunities, and revenue protection. Passion for improving customer experience by leveraging feedback, risk signals, and implementation insights to accelerate time to value. Experience using AI, automation, dashboards, workflow tools, or digital workers to improve operational scale, reporting accuracy, and team efficiency. Ability to enhance implementation quality through scalable project health systems and ensure go-live readiness and post-sale value realization. Experience navigating ambiguity and transformation, adapting to legacy processes and complex customer needs effectively. Strong customer-facing presence with the ability to build trust, communicate clearly, and collaborate with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders, Based in the Eastern Time Zone, US, and eligible to work without sponsorship. Preferred Qualifications Experience with regulated, data-heavy, or complex enterprise software environments such as Product Stewardship, Compliance technology, Sustainability, Healthcare, or Life Sciences industries Experience with ERP integrations, data migration, interoperability, or multi-product enterprise deployments. PMP certification or equivalent project/program management experience. review_candidates.title: Country Director - Thailand
review_candidates.description: Who We Are New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international nonprofit organization supporting entrepreneurs and innovators building the future of clean energy. Across more than 15 countries, we accelerate startups, strengthen clean energy ecosystems, and develop market-based solutions that accelerate the global transition to a clean energy economy. NEX does not develop or sell energy projects itself. We identify gaps that slow clean-energy adoption and bring together entrepreneurs, companies, investors, public-sector stakeholders and funders to address them. Our work is delivered through practical programs such as startup acceleration, workforce development, grants, training, market-access initiatives and industry partnerships, supported by philanthropic, public-sector and corporate funding. NEX has operated in Thailand since 2018. Today, the Thailand chapter is focused on two connected areas: scaling Distributed Energy, including rooftop solar workforce and market development; and building new pathways for Industry Decarbonization by connecting relevant technologies and entrepreneurs with corporate needs. The Role New Energy Nexus is seeking a hands-on, entrepreneurial leader to strengthen NEX Thailand as a resilient, high-performing organization and a trusted clean-energy market builder. This is a Thailand-first leadership role. The Country Director will lead the team, strategy, financial sustainability, organizational development, partnerships and program portfolio, with two immediate strategic priorities: Strengthen and scale the established Distributed Energy work, ensuring strong delivery, institutional resilience and continued market relevance Assess NEX Thailand's existing assets and market opportunities in Industry Decarbonization, then define priority sectors, validate the business model, and build the partnerships, team and funding needed to develop this vertical The Country Director will work across the Thai clean-energy ecosystem, connecting entrepreneurs and smaller businesses with corporates, funders, investors, public-sector actors and other partners. They will need to understand the interests, constraints and incentives of different market participants and turn those insights into practical programs, partnerships and funding opportunities. NEX Thailand operates with a lean team. The successful candidate will therefore be equally comfortable setting direction, representing the organization externally and doing the hands-on work of building teams, systems and delivery capacity. They will build on what already exists while taking ownership of what comes next. Core Accountabilities & Key Responsibilities Lead Vision, Strategy & Organizational Growth Lead and execute a focused multi-year strategy for NEX Thailand around Distributed Energy and Industry Decarbonization Use local-market analysis, partner insight and evidence to identify market gaps where NEX can create distinctive value and measurable impact Make deliberate choices about where the chapter should - and should not - focus, balancing current delivery with longer-term growth opportunities Translate strategic objectives into clear annual priorities, workplans, organizational goals and program or partnership platforms Monitor changes in policy, technology, funding and market demand and adapt the chapter's direction when evidence requires it Fundraising & Partnerships Build on existing and adjacent relationships to develop a diversified pipeline of foundation, corporate, public-sector, multilateral and philanthropic funding opportunities, with support from NEX's global leadership Shape credible, fundable programs and partnerships that respond to real market needs and strengthen NEX Thailand's long-term sustainability Lead or contribute substantially to proposal development, funder engagement, partnership negotiations and relationship management Develop strategic partnerships across the clean-energy ecosystem that improve program delivery, market access and organizational impact Communicate NEX Thailand's results, learning and value proposition credibly to funders, partners, the global NEX network and the wider ecosystem Oversee annual budgeting, financial planning, resource allocation and organizational performance Program Implementation & Team Development Lead and develop a high-performing, collaborative team and ensure NEX Thailand delivers consistently strong results Assess current capabilities and build the team, management practices and operating rhythm needed for the next phase of the chapter's development Ensure the established Distributed Energy portfolio delivers high-quality outcomes in workforce development, entrepreneur support and market activation Lead the validation and development of Industry Decarbonization by assessing market gaps, corporate demand, potential sectors, technologies, partners and sustainable delivery models Oversee NEX Thailand's portfolio of startup acceleration, commercialization, workforce development and ecosystem programs Ensure programs are informed by market evidence, entrepreneur and partner feedback, and clear impact objectives Build long-term program platforms and organizational capabilities rather than relying only on one-off projects or grants Establish appropriate impact measurement, learning and reporting practices, and use evidence to improve programs and resource allocation Develop team members as credible external representatives and future leaders, and foster an inclusive culture of learning, ambition, accountability and care Organizational Governance & Operations Establish clear roles, decision rights, management practices and ways of working that enable accountability, collaboration, transparency and autonomy Oversee appropriate legal, governance and operational arrangements for NEX Thailand and ensure compliance with local regulations and NEX global policies Oversee financial management, organizational risk and operational performance Strengthen the systems and institutional capacity needed for sustainable growth and effective program delivery External Leadership & NEX Network Collaboration Represent NEX Thailand as a credible speaker, convener, thought partner and ambassador within Thailand's clean-energy ecosystem Build trusted relationships with corporates, entrepreneurs, funders, investors, public-sector actors, utilities, development partners and industry organizations Develop NEX Thailand's reputation as a practical bridge builder that helps different market actors overcome persistent barriers to clean-energy adoption and commercialization Share knowledge and best practices across the global NEX network and contribute to cross-country initiatives where they support Thailand's strategy Requirements What We Are Looking For We are looking for a clean-energy institution builder and entrepreneurial general manager: someone who can lead externally while doing the internal work of strengthening a lean team, organizational systems, funding and delivery capacity. The ideal candidate is: Passionate about accelerating Thailand's clean-energy transition and motivated by NEX's mission A hands-on leader who takes ownership, works comfortably with incomplete information and follows through on execution Experienced in building or strengthening a team, business unit, organization, platform or major program - not only administering an established portfolio Able to analyze the local market, understand the needs and constraints of different actors, and translate insight into practical programs, partnerships or business models Commercially and financially literate, while comfortable working in a mission-driven nonprofit environment Credible with senior external stakeholders and able to move between team leadership, market development, program design and funding conversations A systems thinker who can connect entrepreneurs, markets, policy and partnerships without losing sight of practical delivery Highly collaborative, relationship-oriented and effective in an international, matrixed environment Qualifications Bachelor's degree in business, clean energy, entrepreneurship or a related field, or equivalent professional experience Approximately 10 or more years of progressively responsible experience in clean energy, innovation, entrepreneurship, market development, sustainability or a related field, including substantial leadership responsibility Demonstrated success building, transforming or stabilizing a team, organization, business unit, chapter, innovation platform or significant program Direct experience managing people and owning operational, financial or program outcomes Demonstrated ability to analyze and develop local markets in Thailand, including aligning the interests and operating constraints of entrepreneurs, smaller businesses, corporates and other relevant actors Credible understanding of clean-energy markets, technologies and innovation ecosystems. Deep engineering expertise is not required Evidence of creating a new program, platform, partnership or business model from an early or ambiguous stage and taking responsibility for implementation Experience shaping and materially advancing funding or strategic partnership opportunities through grants, corporate partnerships, public-sector funding, philanthropy or other relevant models Strong financial, operational and organizational management capabilities Professional fluency in Thai and English, with excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to represent NEX with senior local and international stakeholders Ability to think strategically while executing effectively in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and resource-conscious environment Experience In One Or More Of The Following Distributed energy, rooftop solar, energy efficiency or related clean-energy markets Industrial decarbonization, climate-tech commercialization or corporate clean-energy innovation Startup acceleration, venture building, innovation ecosystems or technology commercialization Public-private partnerships, corporate partnerships or market-development initiatives International development, donor-funded programs or mission-driven organizations Building organizations or business units through change, growth or complexity Helpful but not required: direct solar project-development or engineering experience, an extensive government network, previous Country Director experience, or regional leadership across Southeast Asia. Strong Thailand-market credibility and demonstrated institution-building capability matter more. Why Join New Energy Nexus? This role offers a unique opportunity to build on an established eight-year track record while shaping the next phase of Thailand's clean-energy transition. As Country Director, you will strengthen an existing team, program portfolio, funding base and network of relationships. You will help scale NEX Thailand's established Distributed Energy work while building a new Industry Decarbonization vertical that connects practical climate solutions with real corporate and market needs. This is an opportunity for a leader who enjoys both building on what exists and imagining what comes next - someone who can preserve the relationships, knowledge and entrepreneurial spirit NEX Thailand has developed while bringing the organizational discipline, commercial judgment and hands-on leadership needed for its next chapter. You will also contribute insight and learning to the global New Energy Nexus network and collaborate with other chapters where this strengthens NEX Thailand's work. Benefits LOCATION The role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, with a hybrid working arrangement. It requires regular engagement with partners, entrepreneurs, government, communities and other ecosystem actors across Thailand, as well as periodic regional and international travel. TO APPLY, TIMELINE, AND PROCESS All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible Submit your resume, cover letter and responses to our application questions. Click the "APPLY FOR THIS JOB" button to begin your application Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until filled New Energy Nexus is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants or employees because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or gender identity or expression of an otherwise qualified individual, or membership in any other class protected by applicable law. New Energy Nexus hires and promotes individuals on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled. We strongly encourage diverse applicants to apply.
